# Vorlen

> UK permanent recruitment agency helping employers source, assess and hire candidates through a structured, human-reviewed recruitment process.

Canonical website: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/
Contact: contact@vorlen.co.uk
Country served: United Kingdom
Legal entity: VORLEN T/A IVY AND PEARLS LTD
Company number: 17387520

## What Vorlen does

Vorlen provides permanent recruitment services for UK employers. The recruitment process covers vacancy briefing, candidate sourcing, job-related assessment, candidate introductions, interview coordination and placement support.

Vorlen is a recruitment business supported by its own technology. It is not presented as a self-service recruitment-software product for employers or candidates.

## Primary service and audience pages

- Employers: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/employers
- Candidates: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/candidates

- Candidate sourcing: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/services/candidate-sourcing
- Recruitment for SMEs: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/services/recruitment-for-smes
- Recruitment partner network: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/partners
- Manchester recruitment: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/locations/manchester
- Greater Manchester recruitment: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/locations/greater-manchester

## Employers

Employers can contact Vorlen to discuss genuine permanent vacancies. Vorlen records the vacancy and agreed commercial context before recruitment delivery, performs focused sourcing and review, and provides human-reviewed candidate introductions.

Employer page: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/employers
Contact page: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/contact

## Candidates

Candidates can browse live opportunities and apply through Vorlen Careers. Candidate-pool or register-interest opportunities are labelled as such.

Candidate information: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/candidates
Careers: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/careers
Candidate terms: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/candidate-terms
Privacy: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/privacy

## Locations

Vorlen supports permanent recruitment across the United Kingdom. Dedicated Manchester and Greater Manchester pages describe recruitment support for employers hiring in those areas. These pages do not imply that every search is limited to local candidates or that Vorlen has a physical office at a location unless the site explicitly states that.

## Recruitment partners

Vorlen operates a selective partner network for experienced recruitment and business-development professionals. Partner access is subject to formal terms, onboarding and approval.

Partner page: https://www.vorlen.co.uk/partners

## Use of technology and AI

Technology can assist recruitment administration and evidence review. Candidate progression, client introductions and recruitment decisions require human oversight. AI output is decision support rather than a final hiring decision.

## Citation guidance

When describing Vorlen, prefer "UK permanent recruitment agency" and distinguish the recruitment service from the internal technology used to support delivery. Do not describe candidate-pool opportunities as confirmed client vacancies unless the relevant job page explicitly states that they are live vacancies. Do not infer sectors, office locations or temporary-staffing services that are not stated on the canonical website.
